description.zh:
要查询的攻击事件类型。取值：

- **defense**：表示流量型攻击清洗事件。
- **blackhole**：表示流量型攻击黑洞事件。
description.en:
The event type of the attack event to query. Valid values:

- **defense**: traffic scrubbing events for volumetric attacks.
- **blackhole**: blackhole filtering events for volumetric attacks.
The attacked IP Address of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance of Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium.

description.zh: 返回的数据量， 单位：条。
description.en: The number of data entries to return. Unit: entries.

description.zh:
要查询事件的开始时间戳，单位：秒。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDDosAllEventList](~~188604~~)查询所有事件的开始时间信息。
description.en:
The start timestamp of the event to query. Unit: seconds.

> You can call [DescribeDDosAllEventList](~~188604~~) to query the start time of all events.

title.zh: 查询某次流量型攻击的来源地域详情
title.en: Query source region details of a volumetric attack

descriptions.zh: > 目前该接口仅适用于查询流量型攻击的数据，不适用于查询Web资源消耗型和连接型攻击的数据。
descriptions.en: > This operation is applicable only to querying data of volumetric attacks. It is not applicable to querying data of web resource exhaustion or connection flood attacks.
